title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---



```{r}

library(readr)

library(tsibble)


data <- read_csv("/Users/helianferraris/Desktop/Forecasting with Applications in Business/Practical 1/smartphone_sales.csv") # data is just a variable name that we choose

# Convert the dataset into tsibble:

smartphone_sales_ts <- as_tsibble(
  data,
  index = month,
  key = model
)

index(smartphone_sales_ts)
key(smartphone_sales_ts)

print(smartphone_sales_ts)

# we can also do --> smartphone_sales_ts %>%  # then we don't have to call smartphone_sales_ts in ggplot() below
ggplot(smartphone_sales_ts, aes(
  x = month, 
  y = units_sold,
  color = model  #distinguishes the two lines
 
)) +
  geom_line() 
  

```
